allowlist.Conv: nn.Conv1d(kernel_size=1), the shared point-wise MLP primitive
allowlist.BatchNormalization: nn.BatchNorm1d in eval mode (affine, running stats). NOT folded into Conv by do_constant_folding; TensorRT fuses Conv+BN at engine-build time
allowlist.Relu: nn.ReLU after every Conv1d/BatchNorm pair and in the head
allowlist.ReduceMax: x.max(dim=2) — the symmetric aggregation that makes the model permutation-invariant
allowlist.GlobalMaxPool: alternative lowering of the same max-pool; accepted if the exporter picks it
allowlist.Gemm: nn.Linear in the classification head and the T-Net regression head
allowlist.MatMul: torch.bmm(t, x) applying a T-Net alignment matrix (teacher config only)
allowlist.Transpose: layout adjustment the exporter may insert around Gemm/MatMul
allowlist.Reshape: TNet.forward's .view(-1, k, k) on the regressed matrix
allowlist.Identity: nn.Dropout in eval mode lowers to a no-op Identity rather than disappearing; TensorRT elides it
allowlist.Constant: the Reshape target shape in TNet, and the ReduceMax axes input at opset >= 18. A frozen initializer, not a runtime op
